title: Coverage recovery Wave 02 part 10 — My Wallet, OneKey Pro, and Phoenix lifecycle depth
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional and must be reallocated against fresh main during canonical promotion. These records use dated first-party release/update material only; none is treated as the original product launch.

events.title: My Wallet v26.8.3 released
events.description: The official My Wallet/MyTonWallet repository released v26.8.3. The release fixed an activity-feed loading failure affecting freshly created Solana wallets and included desktop and Android application artifacts under the continuing My Wallet/MyTonWallet lineage.

events.title: OneKey Pro firmware 4.21.0 released
events.description: OneKey's official Pro firmware update log records system firmware 4.21.0 on 2026-07-03, adding TON sign-data support, updating FIDO authentication, and fixing a QR Wallet signing issue involving legacy-path transactions and security checks.

events.title: Phoenix 2.8.1 released
events.description: ACINQ released Phoenix 2.8.1, adding an iOS debug screen for signing swap-in transactions and fixing an Android amount-display issue.

evidence.title: My Wallet 26.8.3
evidence.notes: Official repository release. Release assets include both MyWallet and MyTonWallet-branded artifacts, consistent with WLR's existing continuous entity lineage across the rebrand.

evidence.title: OneKey Pro Firmware Update Log
evidence.notes: Official OneKey help-center firmware log gives the 4.21.0 release date and change list for OneKey Pro.
